meta.title: K-Bap — read any Korean menu
meta.description: Scan a Korean menu and see every dish in your language, with photos, ingredients, allergy warnings, spice levels and reviews from travelers like you.
hero.sub: Scan a menu in Korean. K-Bap translates every dish and flags what to avoid for you.
hero.freeSub: 10 languages · no account to look around
read.title: Not just translated. Explained.
read.sub: Every dish comes with what it is and what goes into it.
lang.title: Tap a language, read the menu
lang.body: Scan once, then switch between 10 languages. Tap a dish to see what it is and what’s inside.
lang.alt: K-Bap scan result listing each dish with its Korean name, translation, description and ingredient warnings
detail.alt: K-Bap dish detail: what the dish is, its spice level and the ingredients inside
photos.title: No photos? Now there are.
photos.body: Even a menu with only Korean text shows a photo for every dish.
photos.alt: A Korean menu with no photos, next to the same menu in K-Bap with a photo for every dish
eat.title: Know what’s inside before you order.
eat.sub: K-Bap checks every dish against what you avoid, including the ingredients you can’t see.
allergy.title: Safe, caution or avoid, at a glance
allergy.body: Pick what you avoid. Each dish gets marked, and hidden ingredients like fermented shrimp and soybean paste come to the surface.
allergy.alt: K-Bap scan result with each dish rated against the ingredients the user avoids
hidden.label: Hidden ingredient: salted shrimp in the kimchi
hidden.alt: K-Bap ingredient sheet explaining that salted shrimp is used in about 55% of versions of the dish
spice.title: Find your spice level
spice.body: See how hot each dish usually is, and show only the level you can handle.
trust.title: Hear from people like you.
trust.sub: Reviews from travelers around the world, translated into your language.
reviews.title: Reviews from your country first
reviews.body: Filter by nationality and see what people from home thought of each dish.
reviews.alt: K-Bap reviews for a dish, with ratings and the reviewer's country flag
order.title: Show this screen, not a translator app.
order.sub: Your order, in Korean, big enough for the staff to read at a glance.
orderf.title: Order in Korean without speaking it
orderf.body: Add dishes and K-Bap turns them into a large Korean order card, with what to leave out.
orderf.altYours: K-Bap order list with the dishes the user added
orderf.altStaff: K-Bap order card in large Korean text for the restaurant staff
share.title: Share what you ate
share.body: Turn your meals into an Instagram story card, with photos you pick.
cta.title: Order without guessing.
cta.sub: Free on the App Store, in 10 languages.
footer.disclaimer: Ingredient information is a guide, not medical advice.
